page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in the upper and middle part of the page, with a printer's device between the title and the imprint and the date at the foot. The library stamp at the top left and the mirrored show-through of the reverse side are not transcribed.
page.notes: The title lines are set in red and black and are largely illegible under the scan's show-through; the lines marked with counts are not read. Mirrored, upside-down black-letter text from the reverse side shows through the middle of the page and is left out. The library stamp at the top left is left out. The first line and the date are doubtful: the top line is partly covered by the stamp, and the date reads MDCVI or similar. The printer's device between the title and imprint is an ornament and has no text.
